name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: domain = flood_fill (movement-range flood fill), descriptor = neighbor_step (inner step that visits one neighbour tile). No Ghidra address residual in the name. Accurately reflects purpose and matches the parallel naming of its path-aware twin fd2_pathfind_neighbor_step_with_tiebreak @ 0x4E330. Sole caller is fd2_flood_fill_movement_range_recursive @ 0x4E0DC from all four direction branches (xrefs 0x4E0F5/0x4E114/0x4E136/0x4E154), consistent with the name.
purpose: Inner step of the movement-range flood fill: visit one neighbour tile, look up its movement cost via the two-level cost tables, and conditionally rewrite the tile's BTM marker (and signal the caller to recurse) when the new residual cost strictly improves on the existing marker.
logic_summary: Reads the neighbour tile's 16-bit attribute word at btm_attr_ptr-3; its low 10 bits *4 +1 index the primary table (data_fd2_battle_pathfind_tile_cost_table_ptr) to get a secondary index, which indexes the secondary cost table (data_fd2_battle_pathfind_caller_context, the binary's inherited ESI base) to get tile_cost. new_cost = remaining_cost - tile_cost, written out through new_cost_out. Reads flags byte at btm_attr_ptr-1. Commits (rewrites *btm_attr_ptr to new_cost, returns 1) only when affordable (tile_cost <= remaining_cost), strictly improves the current marker (signed compare (int8)*btm < (int8)new_cost), and the tile is not impassable (flags & 0x40 == 0). An 0x80 'movement sink' tile is marked reachable but with residual 0 so the recursion stops expanding past it. Otherwise returns 0. Binary form is a register-passing leaf (CL/EBX/ESI, no stack frame) signalling improvement via the carry flag (CLC=recurse, STC=skip); the emit is the Layer-2 equivalent with int return (non-zero == binary CLC) and the residual handed back via new_cost_out.

params.name: remaining_cost
params.semantics: Residual movement budget at the source tile (binary CL); the amount of movement cost still available when stepping into this neighbour.
params.reason: Accurately names the residual budget; matches binary CL role; no address residual.

params.name: btm_attr_ptr
params.semantics: Pointer to the neighbour tile's BTM marker byte (binary EBX). Raw 16-bit attribute word lives at [-3..-2] and the flags byte at [-1] relative to it; the marker byte itself is at [0].
params.reason: Accurately describes the marker/attr pointer used for all reads/the commit write; matches binary EBX; no address residual.

params.name: new_cost_out
params.semantics: Output parameter receiving the residual cost passed to the neighbour (remaining_cost - tile_cost, forced to 0 for an 0x80 sink). This is how the caller obtains the value (binary CL) it feeds into the recursive descent.
params.reason: Correctly named output param; the _out suffix marks it as an out-parameter; no address residual.

returns.semantics: Non-zero (1) == binary carry-clear (CLC): the tile improved and was committed, so the caller should recurse into it. 0 == binary carry-set (STC): the tile was unaffordable, not an improvement, or impassable; skip and do not recurse.

notes: Name and all three parameter names are already correct and convention-compliant (keep). src comment block (pathfnd.c lines 122-157) is already accurate, refined, and ASCII-compliant; cross-checked against the decompile (two-level cost lookup, signed-strictly-improves gate, 0x40 impassable / 0x80 sink handling, residual-out semantics) -- all match, so comment_verdict=keep.
